aboutpara: Seasoned Software Engineering Manager and Fullstack Developer with a proven track record of optimizing business operations and expediting development processes for organizations with digital presences. Expertise in stakeholder management, data-driven decision-making, supply-chain management, and e-commerce solutions. Experienced in leading cross-functional teams and driving the successful delivery of high-impact software products in distributed computing environments.

resume.tagline: 👋  I'm an engineer, manager, and consultant
resume.description: I have expertise in stakeholder management, data-driven decision-making, supply-chain management, and e-commerce solutions. I am experienced in leading cross-functional teams and driving the successful delivery of high-impact software products in distributed computing environments.

experiences.position: Consultant for Small Business Communities Globally at Ingenierías Lentas
experiences.bullets: Providing support in technical development- communications- and sales. De-silo data to create cohesive business analyses: involving hypothesis- action- and data measurement/validation. Easy and repeatable- producing steadily improving results, Established global community of small businesses- connecting them with industry leaders- with the goal of streamlining the process of product ideation to data validation, Working with business stakeholders to establish an online presence that is scalable- reliable- and secure. Based on modern best practices. Using Shopify- Google Merchant- Meta Business Suite with Python and NodeJS/Typescript/React

Architected and implemented a vendor management and software development management system that improved transparency and security- increased outputs- and maximized use of resources, Used Golang- Java- NodeJS- AWS- and Cloudflare to deliver 4 of 6 keystone ICON Foundation products (Contribution Proposal System- Blockchain Transmission Protocol- ICON General Message Passing- and Balanced Network integration), Created programs for users to build on top of ICON Foundation open-source software products. Generated user feedback- user contributions- and bug bounties: ultimately making the ICON Foundation products more robust and secure. Managed stakeholder expectations among approx. 50 teams

Spearheaded development of the Bitcoin ATM backend asset processing system - enabling growth from 1.400 to 5.000 machines, Established the internal AWS software development platform - incorporating CI/CD - environment separation - and access management
Developed web-based applications using git - Docker - AWS - SQL - Javascript - Python - Go - GraphQL, Collaborated with with clients - negotiated requirements - and delivered high-quality solutions

Built blockchain components for a distributed computing system for managing contributions to the IBM World Community Grid scientific computing software program (approx 3000 global users - tens of thousands of contributor compute hours processed), Participated in startup funding process - business development - and community management

experiences.position: Researcher / Project Manager at Alfred Gessow Rotorcraft Center
experiences.bullets: Created state-of-the-art - resource-constrained aerial robotics systems - including computer vision - controls - and AI using Python (TensorFlow - Pandas), and C++ (ROS - FreeRTOS - Snapdragon SDK), Managed engineering project process for undergraduate - graduate - and third-party collaborators including the U.S. military (task management - budgeting - procurement - reporting), Published papers - wrote contract proposals - and spoke at technical conferences
